column3: Secret Missions: optional finds by reported chapter. Right toggles checkmarks in the list; OK opens details and Check/Uncheck toggles status. Progress saves on SD. Chapter gates marked ? are uncertain.
Safe & Door Codes: browse published numeric codes and passwords by type. [?] marks less-corroborated, conflicting or potentially changing reports. Ordinary robbery safes often have a random code.

Bridges, Cars, Stunts and Collections: each listed entry can be marked Completed. Right toggles a checkmark in its list; OK opens details, with Check/Undo at center. Progress saves to SD and reloads automatically.

Press Right (Emulate) to start the best map or link immediately. GTA6GPS maps come first. Press OK during NFC to browse multiple links, then Up/Down and OK to select. Tap your unlocked phone. Back stops NFC and returns to the checklist with the item highlighted.

Under the Bridge and Stunt Jumps are grouped by county in Collections; Knife Flights and Base Jumps are there too (397 stunts total). Cars include Randy, Moses, Wyman and Standout Vehicles. Collections include cards, scans, flamingos and other finds. Any 300 stunts count toward 100%. A single successful bridge pass or stunt jump gives completion credit; map-icon bonus objectives are optional. Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots: purple = found, white = completed. Aircraft suitability for each span is not verified.

Cocaine Flamingos: destroy the figures with BLACK-WHITE beaks. Black-yellow beaks are decorative; collecting loose cocaine is optional. 103 dedicated records and 41 provisional leads; overlapping reports are not 125 verified unique pickups; 100 of 125 count for 100% completion. Verify the game counter at uncertain map stops.

Magazine Styles: scan with the phone, switch to Jason/Lucia for character-specific unlocks, and inspect private houses when clues point inside.\n\nScan style and tattoo magazines with WAiNK. Collect watches directly. Reported milestones: 10 watches unlock Move Time Forward; 20 unlock Pause Time of Day. 70 of 79 styles count toward 100%.

Diving: Island Dreams unlocks diving. Bring scuba gear, choose the metal detector from lower-right weapon wheel, follow chest markers and dig once light turns GREEN. The nearby wrecks southeast of Key Lento can be visited together.

Optional Missions are a separate Collections checklist; Cal and Kirk already appear in Secret Missions. Messages in Bottles are optional reading, not part of 34 books and swaps. Extra unique weapon names are guide-reported, not game-verified.

Missables: keep a manual save before Tourist Trap (C1) and Checking Out (C2). In C2 pay Linda before Slam Dunk, collect Starlet Motel cards and books, and help Wyman at his car before moving. In C3 take Gil's pistol in Safe Word and Monty's pistol in The Missing Link. Pete's rifle is a C4 mission pickup.

Moses: during Take a Vehicle to Moses (C2), bring an eligible tracker-free car for one free registration. Bison has six cargo slots, Dominator two; Montagne XL waits behind Watkins Auto Parts. Confirm Register shows Free before accepting. See Thrax for reported early access.

Fast Focus leveling: Rodgers Ranch Shooting Range, northeast Port Gellhorn (Kelly County). Buy the $5 waiver and choose Market Range Beginner. Hit all six targets (about 5 sec). Select Quit and back out to the range, then start again. Do NOT choose Restart on results. Each exit is reported to grant permanent Focus; gains vary. Check Jason & Lucia > character > purple eye stat until Level 4. Repeat for the other character after Coffee Break (C2). No cheat activation needed. Patch behavior may change. See Shooting Gold Medals.
Dispatch: select a region. OK checks or undoes the stop. Left (Next) advances to the next unchecked stop. Right (Emulate) opens the location reference when available. Back returns to the region menu.

61 GTA VI effects reported by game guides, but most inputs remain unpublished. [?] marks entries without a code.\n\n21 inputs are corroborated in PS5 and Xbox guides, including Drunk. Pinhole [report] under Filters has a single-source input. The app labels it unverified.

To use: finish the story and the individual cheat's unlock challenge. Check Progress > Cheats. In free roam press D-pad Up to open phone. Hold L1 and R1 (PS5) or LB and RB (Xbox), then enter the D-pad code.
Save before cheats: outlets report no saving or trophies/achievements once a cheat is active in that session. Story Mode only.

Test source: 28 PlayStation controller sequences transcribed, not GTA VI-tested. 24 screenshot-only entries show their sequences in Unverified codes. Four matching effects show the test input as an alternate in the main catalog. Effect matches do NOT verify the test inputs. Xbox equivalents are button-label conversions, not separately sourced codes. TRI=Triangle CIR=Circle SQR=Square; U/D/L/R=direction.

Reported Animals menu: 255 entries; study any 100 for 100% progress. Use binoculars and hold the study button (R1/RB). Aquatic species can be studied by swimming nearby when prompted. Landing fish is a separate activity. Buy lures from fishing-equipped Ammu-Nation stores. Fish pages distinguish reported fish size from lure size; a large fish may take a small lure. F=freshwater; S=saltwater. s/M/L=small/medium/large. ?=not documented. Hunt pages give reported habitat and recommended in-game weapon; use the in-game prompt if sources differ. Eight unique hunts also appear in the existing tracked catalog. All eight Animals categories have reference rosters. Read-only guide: no new checklist IDs. Community map: vice-city.app/map > Animals > species. Points are community map markers, not a guarantee of a live spawn; use the listed species label. Reported sites are guide leads.

Reported optional encounter (By Invitation Only); earliest story gate unconfirmed. Capri pavilion on Beacon Circle, by Bean Machine and gold-painted performer. If officer approaches, interrupt conversation until arrest, then surrender; alternatively bump performer, converse with officers, later surrender to Capri police. Cage escape prompt Square (PS5) / X (Xbox); recover cage keys, reclaim equipment and CPD Moreland 850 from open police-car trunk; free remaining prisoners.

Reference only; not additional checklist IDs.

Clock Out: after Day Release, Jason accepts Lucia's call; pick her up at community center by 16:00 in a vehicle, then drive home. Missable.

Donnie's Lost Drugs: after Swamped, dive southeast portion of search area north of Key Lento, open boat stern compartment and deliver to Brian for $1,200.

Impounded Vehicle: after Coffee Break, collect Lucia's car at Port Gellhorn police lot and clear two-star pursuit.

Get Your Wheels: after Dealer's Choice, recover one impounded car through Scooter Bros or register a replacement with a free garage slot.

Reference only; not additional checklist IDs.

It's a Date!: after Heavy Lifting, bring both characters to Courtyard Bar in Stockyard, buy a drink and exit; relationship benefit.

Bad Driver!: after Party Hard, finish before Power Play. Chase Felipe from Millport bar; killing reportedly pays $20,000, sparing unlocks a later car gift instead.

Dre'Quan's Gift: several days after Photo/Shoot, either character can collect KD's SFB 1000 from alley behind La Perle Pay n Spray.

Story safehouses unlock through the story. Published guides report no house purchases or passive-income businesses in Story Mode. Garages are purchasable; use the Vice City Real Estate phone app when unlocked. Eight purchasable garages cost $160,000 total. Check Garages for exact costs and storage. The Starlet Motel is temporary rented accommodation, not property ownership.

Pool: 17 tables are reported: 10 solo and 7 with opponents. Win at any 5 distinct opponent venues for 100%; beat all 7 for a reported tattoo. A story match that ends early is not necessarily an opponent win. Pool practice raises Focus. Sports challenges: Pool Streak is 3 venues in one day without a loss or quit; Triple Bank and 8-Ball Break are separate. Golf: complete two different mini-golf courses for 100%; Golf Pro requires the 18-hole King Gator and Frontier rounds in the same day at par or better. Full golf is separate. Tennis: courts are mapped, but a scored opponent match has not been established in the reviewed guides.
